%.name: remainder
%.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
%.plain_zh: a % b 是余数 a - b * (a / b)，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

- (unary).name: negation
- (unary).plain: - a is the negation of a.
- (unary).plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

⊕.name: str concat
⊕.plain: a ⊕ b joins string a followed by string b.
⊕.plain_zh: a ⊕ b 把字符串 b 接在 a 后面。

ℓ.name: str length
ℓ.plain: a ℓ is the number of characters in string a.
ℓ.plain_zh: a ℓ 是字符串 a 的字符个数。

↶.name: str reverse
↶.plain: a ↶ reverses the characters in string a.
↶.plain_zh: a ↶ 把字符串 a 倒过来。

⌑.name: str first
⌑.plain: a ⌑ is its first character, or the empty string when a is empty.
⌑.plain_zh: a ⌑ 是 a 的第一个字符，空字符串得空字符串。

⇥.name: str drop
⇥.plain: a ⇥ removes its first character; the empty string stays empty.
⇥.plain_zh: a ⇥ 去掉 a 的第一个字符，空字符串保持为空。

⇧.name: str upper
⇧.plain: a ⇧ changes each lowercase letter in a to uppercase.
⇧.plain_zh: a ⇧ 把 a 中的小写字母改成大写。

⇩.name: str lower
⇩.plain: a ⇩ changes each uppercase letter in a to lowercase.
⇩.plain_zh: a ⇩ 把 a 中的大写字母改成小写。

≡.name: str equal
≡.plain: a ≡ b is true exactly when strings a and b have the same characters.
≡.plain_zh: a ≡ b 在两个字符串完全相同时为真。
